# `System`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.System -- process environment + args + termination
.

Most reads / writes are effectful (`Task Error _`) since they
touch process-global state that can change between invocations.
`getenvOr` is the exception -- when a default is supplied at the
call site, the operation can't fail, so the return is bare
`String`.

## `args`

```ipe
args : () -> Task Error (List String)
```

## `getArg`

```ipe
getArg : Int -> Task Error (Maybe String)
```

`getArg n` -- zero-indexed positional arg lookup.  `Nothing`
if `n` is past the end of the args list.

```ipe
getenv : String -> Task Error String
```

## `getenvOr`

```ipe
getenvOr : String -> String -> String
```

`getenvOr key default` -- returns the env value if present,
otherwise the supplied default.  Sync (no Task) because the
default handles the missing case.

## `loadEnv`

```ipe
loadEnv : () -> Task Error ()
```

Load environment variables from `./.env` (the `.env` file in the
process's current working directory).  Each `KEY=VALUE` line is
parsed; `#` lines and empty lines are skipped; optional surrounding
single or double quotes are stripped.  Already-set variables take
precedence — the process environment wins.  A missing or unreadable
`.env` is silently a no-op.

## `exit`

```ipe
exit : Int -> a
```

Terminate the process with the given exit code.  Polymorphic
return type so this can be the last expression in any case
branch (it never returns to the caller).
